audit: Adversarial re-verification of Kiro's NULLS D83/D84/D85 (config-rotation, within-type convergence, dynamic-adaptive)
summary: All three NULLS (D83/D84/D85) are HONEST refutations, NOT under-powered false-nulls. The verdicts reproduce bit-exactly, the controls are fair, and the multiple-comparison caveats are correctly applied. ONE narrative overclaim found in D83 (see headline_concern): 'DEPLOY THE FROZEN BAND' is not cleanly supported because the random-reselect null mean BEATS the frozen band in 6/12 cells (concentration, not selection-skill, is the lever the experiment surfaces). The D83 verdict that recent-P&L selection has NO SKILL is fully sound; the corollary that frozen is optimal is overstated.

D83_config_rotation.claim: frozen wins 11/12 vs rolling vs random-reselect-null; config rotation by recent P&L has no skill (5th D73 confirmation)
D83_config_rotation.random_null_fairness: FAIR. Rolling and random arms reselect from the SAME full universe, vote across the SAME top_k=10, reselect on the SAME slice cadence, same churn. Only the selection criterion differs (trailing P&L vs random). This cleanly isolates selection skill. SOUND control design.
D83_config_rotation.leak_note: evaluate() uses the SAME leaked btc_regime broadcast (ma_rolling_band_ab.py:173-177, ridx<=dt.normalize() reads same-day daily-close regime) as the leak-check found, but the leak is UNIFORM across frozen/rolling/random arms, so the RELATIVE comparison (the verdict) is leak-robust.
D83_config_rotation.reproduction_match: BIT-EXACT vs original run (rolling_band_ab_20260627_215823.json). Deterministic, seeded. Numbers NOT fabricated.

count_audit.headline_11_of_12_means: 12 minus the 1 skill-win = cells where rolling did NOT win-with-skill. This is a DIFFERENT claim than 'frozen beats rolling' (9/12). Imprecise headline.
count_audit.random_mean_beats_frozen: 6/12 cells (EMA|1d 1.83>1.68, KAMA|1d 1.70>1.58, WMA|1d 1.63>1.60, VIDYA|1d, DEMA|1d, VIDYA|4h)

D83_config_rotation.VIDYA_1d_win_MC_check: rolling 1.925 exceeds random P95 1.774 by only +0.16. Across 12 cells at ~5% FPR ~0.6 false positives expected. Kiro explicitly flags '1/12, likely noise.' HONEST.
D83_config_rotation.verdict: PASS on the core null (recent-P&L selection has no skill). CONCERN on the deployable corollary 'frozen is optimal' (random-10 churn matched/beat frozen in 6/12).

D84_within_type_convergence.claim: within-type top-5 convergence loses to full band 5/6 types; gating hurts
D84_within_type_convergence.design_soundness: SOUND. Top-5 ranked on TRAIN+VAL (2020..2024-05-15) FROZEN, convergence measured OOS-2024. OOS-excluded selection by construction (rank_configs_trainval). No peeking.
D84_within_type_convergence.root_cause_validity: MECHANISTICALLY CORRECT. The 5 top configs within one MA type are near-clones (all same-type crossovers); requiring them to converge = 'one opinion measured 5 ways', no diversification. Confirmed by the data: tightening gate (>=3,>=4,>=5) monotonically HURTS (SMA +1.67 -> +0.60). The KAMA gate>=4 +1.72 exception correctly flagged as 1-of-6-types-x-several-gates MC noise.
D84_within_type_convergence.leak_note: Same leaked regime broadcast (ma_within_type_convergence.py:93), uniform across all arms within a type -> relative comparison holds.
D84_within_type_convergence.verdict: PASS. Honest null. The contrast vs V12 ACROSS-type convergence (orthogonal smoothers DID add +0.1pp) confirms the mechanism is understood, not just observed.

D85_dynamic_endogenous_adaptive.claim: dynamic vov-threshold adaptation (m>0) is VAL-fit, OOS-null; does not transfer
D85_dynamic_endogenous_adaptive.evidence_VAL: m=0.3 BEATS m=0.0 in ALL 8 types on VAL (e.g. EMA edge +2.15 vs +1.46, HMA +3.05 vs +2.33). Dynamic looks great in-sample.
D85_dynamic_endogenous_adaptive.evidence_OOS: Relationship INVERTS on OOS-2024. m=0.0 (static) OOS edges UNIFORMLY POSITIVE (+0.31 to +1.25). m=0.3 (dynamic) OOS edges mostly near-zero/NEGATIVE: HMA -1.41, DEMA -0.29, TEMA -0.64, VIDYA -0.02; only SMA/WMA/KAMA marginally positive (+0.27/+0.39/+0.55) but BELOW their own m=0 twin.
D85_dynamic_endogenous_adaptive.verdict: PASS. Textbook VAL-fit/OOS-null signature (in-sample dominance fully reverses out-of-sample). The 'dynamic adaptation does not transfer' verdict is CORRECT and well-supported. Note: this is also CHARTER-consistent (D85 refutes the endogenous-adaptive vein, not the static MA engine which stays OOS-positive at m=0).

leak_check_verdict_audit.falsifier_correctness: leakcheck_falsifier.py mirrors run_cell exactly, swaps ONLY regime alignment (regime.shift(1) = causal de-leak: day-D bar reads regime[D-1] last CLOSED 1d bar). Reuses verified _load_asset/band/exits/lag-1 MtM. regime_bars_changed_frac=1.7% computed directly. De-leak retains ~85%, all 9 cells stay positive. Mechanism + magnitude both sound.
leak_check_verdict_audit.note: The +1.4-1.6%/wk capped deployable headline de-leaks ~15% to ~+1.2-1.4%/wk. Qualitative conclusions unchanged.

consolidated_selection_thread.consistency: All 4 internally consistent: config CONCENTRATION/SELECTION adds no OOS edge (config performance non-persistent, D62/D73 family, now 6 confirmations); the ONLY convergence that helps is ACROSS orthogonal MA TYPES. Mechanistically coherent.
consolidated_selection_thread.verdict: The dead-list D83-D85 verdicts are HONEST. No under-powered false-nulls detected.

most_important_finding: D83's deployable conclusion 'DEPLOY THE FROZEN BAND' is OVERCLAIMED. The experiment's own random-reselect null mean BEATS the curated 114-config frozen band in 6/12 cells (e.g. EMA|1d random 1.83 vs frozen 1.68). A churning random-10-config book matched or beat frozen in half the cells. The SOUND claim is narrower: 'selection BY RECENT P&L has no skill' (fully supported). But 'frozen is the optimal deployable' does not follow -- the experiment instead surfaces CONCENTRATION (10 configs >> 114-config diluted vote) as a live, untested lever. The '11/12' headline conflates 'rolling did not win-with-skill (11/12)' with 'frozen beats rolling (9/12)'. RECOMMEND: re-baseline the D83 narrative to 'recent-P&L selection NULL; concentration lever flagged for follow-up' and test a frozen-band-at-10-configs vs frozen-band-at-114 cell directly.
